\## Summary

Removes the GPU engine's expectation of bespoke silicon and makes its quantum algorithms scale on the Lucas ladder rungs \*\*10, 12, 15, 18, 20\*\* — the engine now binds to whatever device is actually present (a cloud container's CPU or the user's real GPU) and scales from there. Adoption is the point: \`create\_simulator(0)\` works out of the box on any host.

\*\*Device binding\*\* (\`quantum\_cuda.py\`): \`\_enumerate\_devices()\` replaces the fabricated \`\_DEVICES\` catalogue — it probes \`nvidia-smi\`, \`rocm-smi\`, \`pyopencl\` platforms, Apple Metal, and always appends the real CPU. \`device\_name()\`/\`list\_devices()\`/\`stats()\` report the vendor-reported name plus a backend tag (\`name \[backend\]\`). Out-of-range ids bind to the best device present. Honest split: \`stats()\['bound\_backend'\]\` is the enumerated device class, \`stats()\['backend'\]\` is what the kernel \*executes\* on (\`metal\` or \`cpu\`) — binding a CUDA GPU never masquerades as CUDA compute.

\*\*Lucas scaling\*\*: \`scale\_index\` (on \`QuantumSimulator\`, \`submit\_kernel\`, \`GroverStyleSearch.search\`, and the \`grover\_search\`/\`search\`/\`grover\_iterate\` route) sets \`N\_eff = num\_nonces \* L\_n\` (clamped to \`2\*\*32\`), per the \`grover\_exact\_scale.lucas\_row\` hardware-dimension convention. Grover's k\* is recomputed over \`N\_eff\`; the other algorithms sweep the scaled space. Off-ladder indices raise \`ValueError\`. Knobs: \`QUANTUM\_CUDA\_SCALE\_INDEX\` env, \`set\_scale\_index()\`, \`scaled\_space()\`, \`base\_nonce\` to bind a window.

\*\*Scheduler fix\*\* (needed for scaling to work): \`\_zeckendorf\_schedule(..., limit=)\` fills via the modular Lucas recurrence \`L\_k mod n\` — exact residues without materializing huge Lucas integers — and Grover only materializes its k\* probe offsets. Previously a 46k scaled space hung on bigint arithmetic; now 0.1 s.

\*\*Adoption wiring\*\*: \`quantum\_cuda\` is registered in \`Intelligence/registry.py\` (factory inserts the vendored package root on \`sys.path\`), so \`orchestrator.\_instances\['quantum\_cuda'\]\` finally resolves and \`guide\_mining\` reports \`lucas\_scale\_index\`/\`scaled\_space\`/\`grover\_k\_star\`. \`pythia\_tools\` module paths repointed from the dead \`core\_engine.quantum\_cuda\` namespace to \`turing\_universal\_quantum\_computer.quantum\_cuda\`. \`emit\_grover\_iterate\` forwards \`dispatch\['scale\_index'\]\`/\`lucas\_dispatch\['scale\_index'\]\` into \`GroverStyleSearch\`.

Also fixes the pre-existing IA02 import-audit failure on main (\`scripts/audit\_mla1517\_local.py\` imported \`mla1517.scaling.LADDER\` → \`LUCAS\_PISOT\_LADDER\`).

## Tests

- \`tests/test\_quantum\_cuda\_scale.py\` — 18 tests: enumerated-not-fabricated devices, rung gating (off-ladder \`ValueError\`), \`scaled\_space = N·L\_n\`, \`2\*\*32\` clamp, env override, \`set\_scale\_index\`, Grover k\* bound at scale, \`base\_nonce\` winner, \`GroverStyleSearch\`/route/\`emit\` propagation, registry instantiate.
- The existing \`test\_grover\_depth\_derived\` (depth pinned at unscaled \`floor(π/4·√2\^20)\`) still passes — scaling is opt-in via \`scale\_index\`.
- \`flake8 --count\` 0, \`black --check\` clean, \`scripts/import\_audit.py\` 0 findings.
